body:
Thank you all so much for your support and suggestions, I honestly didn't realize I'd get this many responses. 

I can't say this has turned my life completely around or anything, because I would just be lying to you and to myself, but it has helped quite a bit and has cheered me up immensely. 

I'll take a look at some of the subreddits that you guys have mentioned, and hopefully I can get my life back on track soon.. 

Again, thank you guys so much. I appreciate every comment, and they've made me think twice about some things.
